description: This PHP file defines a controller class for managing subscription reports within the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for displaying the subscription report interface, saving report settings, and generating report data with filtering, pagination, and localization support.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class for handling subscription report functionalities in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the subscription report configuration form with navigation breadcrumbs and loads necessary views.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the report configuration settings via POST request, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Renders the main subscription report page with status filtering and grouping options.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the subscription report list data, primarily a wrapper around getReport().

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates a filtered, paginated subscription report view based on request parameters, including date range, status, and grouping.
